puzzles.caption: When the rains came, Noah trusted God's plan. A warm story of faith, friendship with the animals, and the promise of the rainbow.
puzzles.memoryVerse: I have set my rainbow in the clouds. - Genesis 9:13

puzzles.caption: A young shepherd boy discovers that even when we feel small, God is bigger than every giant we face.
puzzles.memoryVerse: The battle is the Lord's. - 1 Samuel 17:47

puzzles.caption: When the waters rise, Moses trusts God's plan. A brave story of faith, leadership, and the miracle that saved a nation.
puzzles.memoryVerse: The Lord will fight for you. - Exodus 14:14

puzzles.caption: When Jonah runs from God's plan, he ends up in a big adventure. A playful story about obedience, second chances, and how God never gives up on us.
puzzles.memoryVerse: Salvation comes from the Lord. - Jonah 2:9

puzzles.caption: When Daniel keeps praying to God, he is sent into a den of lions. A brave story about faith, prayer, and trusting God when we feel afraid.
puzzles.memoryVerse: My God sent his angel. - Daniel 6:22

puzzles.caption: Even when Esther felt small and afraid, she found the courage to speak up for others. A beautiful story about purpose, faith, and being chosen for.
puzzles.memoryVerse: For such a time as this. - Esther 4:14

puzzles.caption: A tender retelling of the night Jesus was born, filled with wonder, warmth, and the beautiful truth that God came close because He loves us.
puzzles.memoryVerse: A Savior has been born to you. - Luke 2:11

puzzles.caption: Joseph's story shows little hearts how God can work through hard days, surprising turns, and brave forgiveness to bring good in the end.
puzzles.memoryVerse: God intended it for good. - Genesis 50:20

puzzles.caption: A joyful retelling of Jesus' death and resurrection, helping little hearts understand God's greatest rescue with warmth, wonder, and hope.
puzzles.memoryVerse: He is not here; he has risen! - Luke 24:6

puzzles.caption: Walk with Ruth and Naomi through hard times and harvest fields as God weaves faithful love into His greatest plan, from Bethlehem to King David and.
puzzles.memoryVerse: Where you go I will go. - Ruth 1:16

puzzles.caption: A mother's love, a brave big sister, and a tiny basket on the Nile show little hearts how God protects His children from the very beginning.
puzzles.memoryVerse: The Lord is my strength. - Exodus 15:2

puzzles.caption: When God told Solomon he could ask for anything, Solomon chose wisdom. A thoughtful story about listening hearts, wise choices, and asking God for.
puzzles.memoryVerse: The Lord gives wisdom. - Proverbs 2:6

puzzles.bookTitle: Elijah and the Still Small Voice
puzzles.caption: Elijah was brave and faithful, but even brave people can feel tired and afraid. A comforting story about hearing God's gentle voice in quiet moments.
puzzles.memoryVerse: After the fire came a gentle whisper. - 1 Kings 19:12

puzzles.caption: When the wind howled and the waves rose high, Jesus was right there in the boat. A comforting story that reminds little hearts Jesus is near in eve.
puzzles.memoryVerse: Even the winds and the waves obey him! - Matthew 8:27

puzzles.caption: A joyful retelling of Genesis 1 that helps little hearts see the beauty of God's world, from light and sky to animals, people, and rest.
puzzles.memoryVerse: God saw all that he had made, and it was very good. - Genesis 1:31

puzzles.caption: A joyful story from Ephesians 6 that helps little hearts remember God gives us truth, righteousness, peace, faith, salvation, and His Word for ever.
puzzles.memoryVerse: Put on the full armor of God. - Ephesians 6:11

puzzles.caption: A warm, joyful retelling of the little man in the tree, reminding children that Jesus sees every heart and His love can change everything.
puzzles.memoryVerse: The Son of Man came to seek and to save the lost. - Luke 19:10

puzzles.caption: Jesus' parable of a kind helper on the Jericho road teaches little hearts to love their neighbour with compassion, courage, and care.
puzzles.memoryVerse: Love your neighbor as yourself. - Luke 10:27

puzzles.caption: A tender story of the shepherd who searches until he finds the one lost sheep, reminding little hearts that Jesus knows them by name and never give.
puzzles.memoryVerse: Rejoice with me; I have found my lost sheep. - Luke 15:6

puzzles.caption: A sunlit miracle story about a small lunch, a willing child, and Jesus making more than enough for everyone on the hillside.
puzzles.memoryVerse: They all ate and were satisfied. - Matthew 14:20

puzzles.bookTitle: Adam and Eve in the Garden
puzzles.caption: A gentle garden story about God's beautiful beginning, the first family, and the loving care He showed from the very start.
puzzles.memoryVerse: God created mankind in his own image. - Genesis 1:27

puzzles.caption: A joyful story of Joshua, a brave people, and the day God brought Jericho's walls down after they trusted and obeyed.
puzzles.memoryVerse: Be strong and courageous. - Joshua 1:9

puzzles.caption: Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego choose to trust God, even in the fiery furnace, and discover they are never alone.
puzzles.memoryVerse: Our God is able to deliver us. - Daniel 3:17

puzzles.caption: A tender parable about a son who comes home and a loving father who runs to welcome him with forgiveness and joy.
puzzles.memoryVerse: He was lost and is found. - Luke 15:32

puzzles.caption: A warm Gospel story reminding little hearts that Jesus sees children, welcomes them close, and blesses them with love.
puzzles.memoryVerse: Jesus said, Let the little children come to me. - Matthew 19:14

puzzles.caption: A joyful first-miracle story where Jesus cares about an ordinary celebration and fills empty jars with the very best.
puzzles.memoryVerse: Do whatever he tells you. - John 2:5

puzzles.caption: A tender story of honest prayer, a long-awaited gift, and young Samuel learning to listen when God calls his name.
puzzles.memoryVerse: Speak, Lord, for your servant is listening. - 1 Samuel 3:9

puzzles.caption: A bright Damascus-road story showing little hearts that Jesus can change anyone and make every heart new.
puzzles.memoryVerse: He is my chosen instrument. - Acts 9:15

puzzles.caption: An exciting Acts story about choosing joy in hard places, singing at midnight, and seeing God open doors.
puzzles.memoryVerse: Believe in the Lord Jesus. - Acts 16:31

puzzles.caption: A joyful Pentecost story showing little hearts that Jesus sent the Holy Spirit, our Helper, so we are never alone.
puzzles.memoryVerse: All of them were filled with the Holy Spirit. - Acts 2:4

puzzles.caption: A warm story of God's provision, showing little hearts that when we bring what we have and trust Him, He can fill every empty place.
puzzles.memoryVerse: My God will meet all your needs. - Philippians 4:19

puzzles.caption: A thoughtful Genesis story reminding little hearts that when people forget God, plans can fall apart, but God still leads us with love.
puzzles.memoryVerse: The Lord confused the language. - Genesis 11:9

puzzles.caption: A brave Judges story showing little hearts that God can use the small and weak to do mighty things.
puzzles.memoryVerse: The Lord is with you, mighty warrior. - Judges 6:12

puzzles.caption: A steady story about praying first, planning carefully, working with courage, and trusting God to help us finish what matters.
puzzles.memoryVerse: The God of heaven will give us success. - Nehemiah 2:20

puzzles.caption: A faith-filled Gospel story reminding little hearts that when we feel like we are sinking, Jesus reaches out His hand.
puzzles.memoryVerse: Take courage! It is I. Don't be afraid. - Matthew 14:27

puzzles.caption: A tender John 11 story showing that Jesus cares about our tears and that with Him, there is always hope.
puzzles.memoryVerse: Jesus said, I am the resurrection and the life. - John 11:25
